title: A.e. weighted approximate tangent planes, measurability of p_x, and density = theta (Simon Ch. 3, 1.9, 1.8)
statement: Let n >= 1, l >= 0, U an open subset of R^(n+l) and V = v(M, theta) a contract rectifiable n-varifold in U (M = V.carrier, theta = V.mult, mu = V.weight = theta H^n restricted to M). Then (a) for mu-a.e. x there is an n-dimensional subspace P which is the approximate tangent space of M with respect to theta at x in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Def. 1.7 (SimonGMT HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M theta x P), and V.tangentProj x is the orthogonal projection onto P; (b) x -> V.tangentProj x is mu-a.e. strongly measurable; (c) for mu-a.e. x, mu(B_r(x))/(omega_n r^n) -> theta(x) as r -> 0+ (V.HasDensity x (theta x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n V.carrier V.mult x P ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, V.HasDensity x (V.mult x)
